evals.prompt: Use the work-items skill. Create a work item in project TaskFlow: 'Fix login 500 on Safari', high priority, 3 points, assigned to Alice, labeled 'bug'. Show every call including how names become ids, and the description you write. In this session you have no Plane tools and no shell, only file reading and a text answer: say which Plane MCP calls you would make (resource(action=..., ...) with their parameters), in what order, and what you would check, and show the result you would give me.
evals.expected_output: project(action=list), member(action=list_project), label(action=list), then workitem(action=create) with description_html, priority, point, assignees and labels.
expectations: The answer finds the project with project(action=list)
The answer resolves Alice's user id with member(action=list_project, project_id=<id>)
The answer resolves the label bug to its id with label(action=list, project_id=<id>)
The answer writes description_html with an Acceptance Criteria heading
The answer sets priority="high" and point=3 in the workitem(action=create) call
The answer sets assignees=[<Alice's uuid>] and labels=[<bug label uuid>] in the workitem(action=create) call

The answer resolves PROJ-140 with workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-140")
The answer calls workitem_relation(action=create) with workitem_id=<PROJ-148 uuid>

The answer passes workitem_ids=[<PROJ-140 uuid>]
The answer reads the relation back with workitem_relation(action=list)

evals.prompt: Use the work-items skill. Show me every urgent or high priority item assigned to me in TaskFlow that is still open, and how many items each person has in progress.
